title: Failed Stripe events, resync and invoices
caption: Needs FEATURE_STRIPE_BILLING (or FEATURE_OWN_STRIPE for the events page), Stripe test keys and stripe listen. See runbook §3.

steps.title: Open the inbox
steps.body: Dashboard 'failed Stripe events' or the nav.
steps.expect: Failed and ignored first; id, receiver, type, status, attempts, last error (`CODE: message`), OTA, times.

steps.title: Fix the cause, then Reprocess
steps.body: E.g. `UNKNOWN_PRICE`: link the price on `/plans/<code>`. Then **Reprocess** → **Reprocess event**.
steps.expect: 'queued, reload later'; after reload the event is received → processed; audit `stripe_event.reprocessed`. An event that moved meanwhile answers `409` worded.

steps.title: Resync one subscription
steps.body: On a Stripe row with a Stripe subscription: **Resync from Stripe** → **Resync now**.
steps.expect: Status and period end as Stripe has them; every 409 reason worded (unknown_price, subscription_busy …); 502 = nothing changed.

steps.title: Invoices
steps.expect: Amounts in the invoice currency's decimals (`€149.00`, `¥5,000`); Stripe page/PDF links only when `https:`.
